purpose: Manual GitHub Desktop / VS Code data source for ChatGPT-assisted projects.

versioningModel.rule: When publishing a new version to GitHub, create a new self-describing area-vN folder and use filenames that include the area and version.

targetedGenerationRule: Files can be regenerated individually because each folder and filename identifies its area, version, and purpose.

protocols.manualSync: ChatGPT generates clean downloadable files; user commits them manually through VS Code or GitHub Desktop.
protocols.neverOverwritePublishedHistory: When saving to GitHub, create the next version folder instead of overwriting an existing published folder.
protocols.localWorkingFiles: Local working files may be regenerated or replaced during iteration before being committed.
protocols.highestVersionRule: When loading from GitHub, prefer the highest numbered area-vN folder visible in the target area.
